如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    林逸很是庆幸，自己差一点儿就忘记时间！
这要是真错过了，石门关闭将自己关进了里面，那自己还练个屁神功啊，除非能练成神仙不吃不喝，不然早晚饿死。
当东方第一缕阳光照射在了山谷中，林逸面前的石门，毫无征兆的，陡然间发出了机关的声响，“轰隆”一声，合了上来。
等石门合上之后，林逸再次的来到了石门跟前，不过，这次任凭林逸怎么弄，石门都是安安静静，毫无看来第一个石碑上面写的那八句话并没有骗自己，这石门如果关闭了，的的确确的就打不开了，要想再次开启，必须要等到五年之后才行。
虽然林逸有些微微的失望，不过还好这个秘籍的箱子却拿到了手中，一切就等回去研习之后再做定夺了。
“小逸，你没事儿吧？”
一个熟悉的声音在林逸的身后响起，林逸一转头却发现，不知道什么时候，林老头居然已经出现在了自己的身后。
“靠！老头子，你想踢死我啊？从那么高的山上给我来了一个空中飞人，你真当我是超人呢啊？”
林逸想到昨晚自己从山顶摔下来，现在浑身的骨头还隐隐有些作痛。
“你这不是没死么？”
林老头看到林逸没事儿，心里着实的一松。
虽然之前他一直表现的很镇定，其实心中也很忐忑的。
毕竟林逸从这么高的山上掉下去，虽然他的身体经过自己调制的中药浸泡，但是林老头其实也没底。
“没死也差不多了。”
林逸犹豫着是不是将自己之前的所见所闻告诉林老头，不过犹豫了一下，决定还是将事情原原本本的说出来，毕竟林老头见多识广。
“老头，我昨天进入这个山洞了……”
林逸指着身后不远处的山洞石门对林老头说道。
“恩……”
林老头之前已经看到了林逸手中的盒子，也知道了他昨晚肯定去过山洞里了。
不过此刻听到林逸亲口承认，心中还是很欢喜的。

至少林逸没有将他当做外人，也不枉他将林逸拉扯大。
“然后……”
林逸不知道林老头什么意思，于是就将自己进入山洞后的所见所闻告诉了林老头，最后将手中的盒子递到了林老头的面前道：“这就是那个盒子了！”
“你自己收着吧。”
林老头看了盒子一眼，淡淡的说道。
“你不看看？”
林逸很纳闷，这么奇妙的事情，林老头怎么丝毫不在意一样呢？
“看也没用。”
林老头摇了摇头。
虽然林逸有很多的疑问，但是林老头这种“你别问我”，“你愿意怎么样就怎么样”的态度让林逸欲言又止。
和林老头一起，从山谷底里的岔道很艰难的回到了家中，林老头倒床上就睡了，只留下林逸自己抱着个盒子大眼瞪小眼。
既然林老头对此表现的无比淡漠，林逸也只能自己研究盒子里的东西了。
林逸将盒子放在破八仙桌上，开始研究了起来。
小盒子做的古香古色，就像是过去皇宫里盛放圣旨或者是丹药之类的那种木盒。
不过却没有上锁，林逸将盒子上面的卡扣林逸瞪大了眼睛，呼吸都开始变得急促了起来！
终于，盒盖将卷宗拿起来，却见得在盒子的底部有一块玉佩，林逸忙将玉佩拿了起来，放在灯光下仔细的看了起来。
玉佩的质地非常好，但是却很奇特，上面雕刻的是一种类似图腾的图案，还有林逸看不懂的文字。
绝对不是篆体，这个玉佩和卷宗上面的文字明显的不是一系。
这让林逸有些奇怪，按理说，不论是山洞里，还是卷宗上，文字都是统一的，只有这块玉佩，情况却很特别。
后来林逸也曾经拿着玉佩问过林老头，但是林老头也不清楚玉佩到底是做什么的，甚至林老头看到玉佩之后，露出了十分惊讶的表情来。

后来，林逸也只能凭借自己的推断，猜测这块玉佩是配合练功用的，于是就一直将玉佩戴在了身上。
林逸小心翼翼的将卷宗展了开来，却微微有些失望。
卷宗很薄，只有一张丝巾而已。
不过，林逸也看过那些玄幻小说，明白厉害的秘籍不在于字数的多少。
所以，林逸还是怀着十分憧憬的心态“轩辕驭龙诀”五个篆体书写的大字立刻映入了林逸的眼帘。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Lin Yi was so lucky that he almost lost track of time!
If he really misses this and the stone door closes and locks him in, then he still has to practice magic skills. Unless he can become a god who neither eats nor drinks, he will starve to death sooner or later.
When the first ray of sunshine from the east shone on the valley, the stone door in front of Lin Yi suddenly made a sound of mechanism without any warning, and closed with a "bang".
After the stone door was closed, Lin Yi came to the stone door again. However, no matter what Lin Yi did, the stone door was quiet this time. It seemed that the eight sentences written on the first stone tablet did not lie to him. If the stone door is closed, it will indeed not be opened. If you want to open it again, you must wait until five years later.
Although Lin Yi was slightly disappointed, fortunately, he got the box of secrets in his hands. He would only make a decision after going back to study.
"Xiaoyi, are you okay?"
A familiar voice sounded behind Lin Yi. Lin Yi turned around and found that at some point, Old Man Lin had appeared behind him.
"Fuck! Old man, do you want to kick me to death? A trapeze artist came to me from such a high mountain. Do you really think I am Superman?"
Lin Yi thought about how he fell from the top of the mountain last night, and the bones all over his body were still aching.
"Aren't you alive?"
Old man Lin felt relieved when he saw that Lin Yi was fine.
Although he had always behaved calmly before, he was actually very uneasy in his heart.
After all, Lin Yi fell from such a high mountain. Although his body was soaked in Chinese medicine prepared by himself, Old Man Lin actually had no idea.
"It's almost as good as not dying."
Lin Yi hesitated whether to tell Old Man Lin what he had seen and heard before, but after hesitating for a while, he decided to tell the truth. After all, Old Man Lin was well-informed.
"Old man, I entered this cave yesterday..."
Lin Yi pointed to the stone door of the cave not far behind him and said to Old Man Lin.
"Well..."
Old man Lin had seen the box in Lin Yi's hand before and knew that he must have been in the cave last night.
But now I heard Lin Yi admit it personally, I was still very happy.
At least Lin Yi didn't treat him as an outsider, nor did he bring Lin Yi up in vain.
"Then..."
Lin Yi didn't know what Old Man Lin meant, so he told Old Man Lin what he saw and heard after entering the cave. Finally, he handed the box in his hand to Old Man Lin and said, "This is the box!"
"You can keep it yourself."
Old man Lin glanced at the box and said calmly.
"Don't you look at it?"
Lin Yi was very puzzled, why did Old Man Lin not care at all about such a wonderful thing?
"It's useless to look at it."
Old man Lin shook his head.
Although Lin Yi had many questions, Old Man Lin's "don't ask me" and "just do whatever you want" attitude made Lin Yi hesitate to speak.
Together with Old Man Lin, we returned home through the forked road at the bottom of the valley with great difficulty. Old Man Lin fell on the bed and fell asleep, leaving Lin Yi alone holding a box and staring with big eyes.
Since Old Man Lin was extremely indifferent to this, Lin Yi could only study the contents of the box by himself.
Lin Yi placed the box on the Broken Eight Immortals table and began to study it.
The small box is made of antique color, just like the wooden boxes used to hold imperial edicts or elixirs in the palace in the past.
However, it was not locked. Lin Yi opened the buckle on the box. Lin Yi's eyes widened and his breathing began to become rapid!
Finally, the box lid lifted up the file, only to see a jade pendant at the bottom of the box. Lin Yi quickly picked up the jade pendant and looked at it carefully under the light.
The texture of the jade pendant is very good.But it was very strange. There was a totem-like pattern carved on it, and there were words that Lin Yi couldn't understand.
It's definitely not in seal script. This jade pendant is clearly not the same as the text on the dossier.
This made Lin Yi a little strange. It stands to reason that whether it is in the cave or in the file, the words are consistent. Only this jade pendant is in a special situation.
Later, Lin Yi also asked Old Man Lin with the jade pendant, but Old Man Lin didn't know what the jade pendant was for. Old Man Lin even showed a very surprised expression after seeing the jade pendant.
Later, Lin Yi could only rely on his own inference and guessed that this jade pendant was used for practicing martial arts, so he kept wearing it on his body.
Lin Yi carefully unfolded the file, but was slightly disappointed.
The file is very thin, only a silk scarf.
However, Lin Yi has also read those fantasy novels and understands that the most powerful secret is not the number of words.
Therefore, Lin Yi still had a very longing mentality. The five big characters "Xuanyuan Yulong Jue" written in seal script immediately caught Lin Yi's eyes.
